class.name: JRPGCharacterSprite
class.brief_description: A character on the map, drawn from its character sheet.
class.description: Shows the [SpriteFrames] [JRPGCharacterSheet] cuts from a character sheet, with the character's feet on the bottom edge of its cell (a sheet's y offset draws it higher) and the animation of the way it faces. The frames are set, never played: while the character walks they go round in order, one every half cell walked ([constant FRAMES_PER_CELL] a cell), so a step looks the same at every speed; standing, it shows frame 0. The node sits at the middle of the character's cell; [method show_state] updates it from the character's facing and how far it has walked ([method JRPGMover.get_walk_distance]). Authority: client. It only shows what the character's mover says (online, the server's).

method.name: get_cell_size
method.description: Returns the size of the map's cells, in pixels.

method.name: get_walk_frame
method.description: Returns the walk frame shown [param walk_distance] cells into a walk on a sheet with [param frame_count] frames: frame 1 on the first half cell, then round in order (1, 2, 3, 0, 1, ... with four frames). Returns 0 when [param frame_count] is 0.

method.name: set_cell_size
method.description: Sets the size of the map's cells, in pixels, which places the feet on the cell's bottom edge.

method.name: set_character_frames
method.description: Draws the character with [param frames], as [method JRPGCharacterSheet.make_frames] or [method JRPGCharacterSheet.load_frames] give them.

method.name: show_state
method.description: Shows the character facing [param direction], walking when [param moving] is [code]true[/code] (with the frame for [param walk_distance] cells walked, as [method JRPGMover.get_walk_distance] counts them) or standing.

constants.constant: How many walk frames go by for each cell walked.
